units: SI in this file (m, t, shp, kn); the legacy kernel converts once at the boundary
note: Measured sea-trial power and speed for warships, each with its own provenance. The set is an asset, not a fitting set: every figure carries a source, a trial kind and the load condition it was taken at, because mixing those moved one ship's error by thirteen points.

fields.hull: length_m with length_basis (lbp|loa), beam_m, draught_m, displacement_t, block_coeff with its basis
fields.source: url, retrieved, quote — the sentence the figure came from
fields.model: predicted_hp, error_pct, commit — the plimsoll result this datum pins

trial.load_note: as-built normal load; draught nearer deep load than the 26.5 ft normal figure

source.quote: the ship reached 21.6 knots from 27,018 shp during her sea trials on 9 October 1906

verification.notes: also recorded by Parsons as 24,712 hp at 21.25 kn; 27,018 is the trial-record figure used here

hull.block_coeff_basis: trial displacement over LBP*B*T with the deep-load draught
